data.additional_information:
To build the perception, decision-making, and computational intelligence layers of our autonomous platforms. The role spans deep learning for perception (vision, LiDAR, sonar, acoustic), reinforcement learning for policies, sensor fusion, scientific machine learning, and high-performance computing for simulation-driven design. PhD candidates will be considered for senior roles with ownership of a research workstream — model architecture, RL for autonomy, or scientific ML for design optimization.
Job Responsibilities-
1 Develop deep-learning models for object detection, classification, tracking, segmentation, and re-identification across EO/IR cameras, LiDAR, sonar, and radar.
2 Build learned and hybrid sensor-fusion pipelines combining cameras, IMU, GNSS, LiDAR, and Sonar. Develop end-to-end / modular approaches for robust state estimation in challenging environments. 
3 Train and deploy RL policies for navigation, swarm coordination, and mission decision-making in simulation (Isaac Gym, Isaac Sim) with sim-to-real transfer. 
4 Build custom neural networks and use physics-informed neural networks and reduced-order models to accelerate design cycle. 
5 Build data collection, labelling, training, and deployment pipelines. Manage datasets, model versioning, and continuous evaluation against operational benchmarks.
6 Profile and optimize compute pipelines on GPU clusters for large-scale simulation, training, and design optimization runs 
7 Take models from research to deployment — quantization, pruning, engine optimization — and integrate with the autonomy stack on real hardware.
Skills Required
1 Strong fundamentals in machine learning, deep learning, optimization, linear algebra, and probability. 
2 Proficiency in Python with PyTorch / JAX / TensorFlow; comfortable with C++ for production deployment. 
3 Hands-on experience with computer vision (CNNs, transformers), 3D perception (PointNet, voxel-nets), or generative models. 
4 Working knowledge of reinforcement learning frameworks (Stable Baselines, RLlib, Isaac Gym) and sim-to-real techniques. 
5 Familiarity with scientific ML — physics-informed networks, neural surrogates, operator learning — is a strong plus for Computational & Data Sciences candidates.
6 Experience with NVIDIA Jetson, TensorRT, DeepStream, and on-device optimization.
7 Comfortable with MLOps tooling — Weights & Biases / MLflow, DVC, Kubeflow — and reproducible experiment management.

Qualification-PhD/ M.Tech / M.Tech (Research)
Experience-0-2 Yrs

Dear Applicant, 

Please find below the additional important details regarding our Company Clauses & Policies:

1.NDA – Non-Disclosure Agreement
Candidates must not disclose or share any confidential information related to their job role, projects, company operations, or work responsibilities with any external party. This clause will remain applicable for a lifetime.
2.NCC – Non-Compete Clause
Upon joining the company, when you decide to leave the organization in the future, you will not be eligible to join any direct competitor of the company for a period of 3 years post the last working day.
3.Minimum Service Agreement – 2 Years
Candidates from any branch having less than 2 Years of Experience are required to sign a mandatory 2-year Minimum Service Agreement. However, Candidates with more than 2 years of prior experience are exempted from the Minimum Service Agreement.  Additionally breach of this agreement will result in a financial penalty of 40% of the CTC.
